title: Grayton Beach "Four Fish Cottage" 20 Cottage Street
h1: Grayton Beach "Four Fish Cottage" 20 Cottage Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Community Pool- Close proximity to local dining establishments - fantastic food and lively atmosphere- Short walk to the beach- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Four Fish Cottage is a delightful cottage located 5 houses off the beach in the popular Grayton Beach community. Guests will love access to the community pool (conveniently located directly next door), proximity to local restaurants, and nearby Western Lake for fishing and canoeing. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home comfortably sleeps 9.As you enter this 3-story cottage retreat, notice the detailed finishings on the first floor, including 9-foot-tall ceilings and hardwood floors, along with natural colors and textures to compliment the beach vibes. Entertain family and friends in the spacious living room with natural lighting on 2 oversized sofas and 2 linen armchairs. Adjacent to the living area, you’ll find plenty of room for a sit-down dinner with 11 total seats at 2 different tables—and don’t forget the 2 stools at the kitchen island/breakfast bar where you can watch the chef prep dinner. Making dinner was never easier with stainless steel appliances, farmhouse sink, and ample cabinet space. Down the hall is a ground-floor guest bedroom with 1 queen bed with private bath.Make your way to the second floor for all the cozy sleeping accommodations—1 primary suite with king bed and private bath with jacuzzi tub, 1 guest bedroom with king bed and private bath, and an additional guest bedroom with a full-over-full bunk bed and 1 twin day bed. The second-floor deck, off the primary suite, is perfect for watching the sunrise and sunset.For a little extra privacy, try the third-floor balconies for incredible views of the Gulf or for a nightcap under the stars.Any coastal home would only be complete with a screened-in porch to relax and unwind on. And just off the porch is a lovely patio with Adirondack chairs and charcoal grill for outside entertainment.For a little more adventure, try the 4 adult bikes to explore the area. While staying at Four Fish Cottage, the world is your oyster. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Jacuzzi Tub separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed and one Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*There is space for two vehicles to park in front of the home, but ideally one vehicle would fit best as space is tight.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Grayton Beach "Four Fish Cottage" 20 Cottage Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-030676 Bedrooms 4 Beds 5 Sleeps 9 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Community Pool - Close proximity to local dining establishments - fantastic food and lively atmosphere - Short walk to the beach - 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Four Fish Cottage is a delightful cottage located 5 houses off the beach in the popular Grayton Beach community. Guests will love access to the community pool (conveniently located directly next door), proximity to local restaurants, and nearby Western Lake for fishing and canoeing. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home comfortably sleeps 9. As you enter this 3-story cottage retreat, notice the detailed finishings on the first floor, including 9-foot-tall ceilings and hardwood floors, along with natural colors and textures to compliment the beach vibes. Entertain family and friends in the spacious living room with natural lighting on 2 oversized sofas and 2 linen armchairs. Adjacent to the living area, you’ll find plenty of room for a sit-down dinner with 11 total seats at 2 different tables—and don’t forget the 2 stools at the kitchen island/breakfast bar where you can watch the chef prep dinner. Making dinner was never easier with stainless steel appliances, farmhouse sink, and ample cabinet space. Down the hall is a ground-floor guest bedroom with 1 queen bed with private bath. Make your way to the second floor for all the cozy sleeping accommodations—1 primary suite with king bed and private bath with jacuzzi tub, 1 guest bedroom with king bed and private bath, and an additional guest bedroom with a full-over-full bunk bed and 1 twin day bed. The second-floor deck, off the primary suite, is perfect for watching the sunrise and sunset. For a little extra privacy, try the third-floor balconies for incredible views of the Gulf or for a nightcap under the stars. Any coastal home would only be complete with a screened-in porch to relax and unwind on. And just off the porch is a lovely patio with Adirondack chairs and charcoal grill for outside entertainment. For a little more adventure, try the 4 adult bikes to explore the area. While staying at Four Fish Cottage, the world is your oyster. Book now!
